featured_reviews.name: Riya Desai
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had an extremely disappointing and frustrating experience with DTDC Bhandup (Mumbai), and I strongly advise others to be very cautious while dealing with this branch.

Right from the start, the staff showed a complete lack of knowledge about their own services and delivery process. They accepted our courier and confidently assured us that it would be delivered to Jaipur within 5 days. At no point were we informed that DTDC does not deliver to the given Jaipur address. Had this been clearly communicated at the time of booking, we would never have handed over the parcel.
Later, we were shocked to find that the courier was stuck at the Jaipur RTO due to non-serviceability and was then rerouted to Bangalore without any prior intimation. From there, it remained stuck for another two days. Throughout this period, the manager Prahlad kept giving us repeated assurances that the parcel was being “expedited” and would be delivered soon.

Whenever we questioned the issue, the only explanation given was that it was a “human error.” However, despite admitting the mistake multiple times, no real effort was made to rectify it. Instead of taking responsibility and finding a solution, we were given false hopes and misleading updates.
The parcel contained ladus (food items), and due to careless handling and unnecessary movement across cities, the contents were completely damaged. There was absolutely no care taken, even after knowing that the parcel contained food items.

Even after assuring us more than 10 times that the parcel would be delivered to Jaipur, it was eventually sent back to us in Mumbai. This entire episode caused immense mental stress, frustration, and loss of time.
On top of this, the behavior of the staff and manager was extremely rude and unprofessional. They lack basic manners and ethics while dealing with customers. Once the issue arose, they stopped answering our calls, forcing us to physically visit their office just to get updates on a stuck courier.

Overall, this has been one of the worst courier experiences we have ever had. Poor communication, zero accountability, repeated “human error” excuses without corrective action, damaged goods, and complete unprofessionalism define this branch.

DTDC Bhandup and Manager Prahlad need serious training in customer handling, accountability, and basic professionalism
